Container.Name: claude-code
Container.Overview: Always-on Claude Code, reachable from the Claude app through Remote Control (server mode). Claude Code installs into the Home folder on first start and updates itself. Home holds the login, settings, CLAUDE.md, skills and scripts; Projects is the working folder. Both folders must be owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Login, settings, CLAUDE.md, skills, scripts, key files and Claude Code itself

Config.Name: Remote Control name
Config.Description: Prefix for session names in the Claude app

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for scheduled jobs and logs
